semantics: six keys 0..5, six values 0..5, three key=value facts per fact-set, one queried value per example

split_rule.algorithm: sort held-out fact-sets by sha256(json(canonical signature)), tie-break by signature; even rank BIND_CONTROL, odd rank BIND_SEALED

source_identity_note: Commit identifies checkout base; source_sha256 binds working-tree contents.
